summary: WiseKey International Holding AG filed a Form 6-K furnishing two exhibits: a September 11, 2026 press release and half-year report of its subsidiary SEALSQ Corp. The disclosure covers SEALSQ's H1 2026 results, with revenue up 131% to $11.2 million, gross margin near 48%, operating loss of $32.2 million, net loss of $27.8 million, and $486.1 million in cash at June 30, 2026. FY2026 revenue guidance of $27-36 million was reaffirmed, and a September 15 conference call was noted. This is a routine foreign-private-issuer earnings filing, not a special situation; the prior IC Alps deal is referenced only as historical context.
